description: Canonical signing-byte reuse experiment, actual saved pre-prototype baseline binary versus candidate. Three paired repeats/load, alternating mode order by trial. Five-second offered windows,1900/2000TPS,20msone-waydelay,5sdeadline,16384inflight,64request/1ms durablegroupcommit. Real signatures verified on every check; no digest-signing or signature-result cache. Normal release builds; detailed queue diagnostics disabled. Shared8-logical-CPU macOShost. No deliberate simultaneous builds/tests/profilers during these runs. Private per-run fixtures removed only after recovery audits and public-report capture to bound disk use.

report.measurement_definition: Signed transaction submission before transport enqueue to client receipt and strict Ed25519 verification of effects QC; client generation/signing excluded; network queues, fixed per-direction delay, validator validation/signing and group sync_all before votes included.
report.limits: One host, loopback TCP, fixed one-way delay without packet-loss/bandwidth modelling; one hot collective pool; bounded journal group commit; filesystem/device sync_all guarantees assumed. Finalized latency percentiles are conditional; all-submitted quantiles include right-censored stalls.

decision: Prototype removed after mixed results: ~3.85% higher median finalized TPS at1900 offered, ~0.73% lower at2000, and worse one-second finality at2000. Extra retained Act snapshots/canonical bytes were not justified by a consistent end-to-end gain. Deadline FIFO fix, real cryptography, admission and durable journal behavior remain unchanged.
scope: Host-only representation cache. Client vote canonical bytes reused during certificate rechecking; actor signing bytes reused only after complete Act equality. Core vote-preimage construction, message-content hashing and object-size encoding were unchanged. No signature-result cache or hash-then-sign scheme was introduced.
counter_result: Client encoded seven vote preimages per finalized transaction instead of thirteen in these runs, saving six encodings. Strict Ed25519 checks still ran for each verification.
